constraints.name: interesting_element_definition
constraints.description: 数组的每个元素必须形如2^x - 1,其中x是整数且满足1 ≤ x ≤ 60。

constraints.name: xor_sum_equality
constraints.description: 数组所有元素的按位异或和必须等于给定的整数C。

constraints.name: minimum_size_requirement
constraints.description: 在所有满足条件的数组中,必须输出尺寸最小的数组；若存在多个,输出任意一个。
constraints.formal: minimize n subject to a_k = 2^{x_k} - 1, 1 ≤ x_k ≤ 60, ⨁_{k=1}^n a_k = C

objective.description: 求解满足异或条件的最小规模数组大小

invariants.name: mersenne_element_form
invariants.description: Every element of the constructed array is of the form 2^k - 1, satisfying the definition of interesting array.

invariants.name: minimal_size_corresponds_to_bit_transitions
invariants.description: For C > 0, the number of elements in the output array equals the number of transitions between consecutive bits in the binary representation of C plus one. This yields the minimum possible size.

invariants.name: prefix_xor_match
invariants.description: During the scan of bits from most significant to least significant, the XOR of the elements generated so far matches the prefix of C up to the currently processed bit, ensuring correct accumulation towards the target.

original_problem.title: MINSZ
original_problem.description:
Consider an array A = \{a_{1}, a_{2},...,a_{n}\} of size n ≥ 1. If a_{k} = 2^{x} -1 for all  1≤ k ≤ n,  for some integer x (1 ≤ x ≤ 60), then A is called interesting array.

You are given a number C. Find any interesting array A of minimum possible size such that  a_{1} \bigoplus a_{2} \bigoplus...\bigoplus a_{n} = C, where \bigoplus represents bitwise XOR operation.

If there exists multiple such arrays, output any one.

------ Input Format ------ 

- First line will contain T, number of testcases. Then the testcases follow.
- Each testcase contains single integer C on a single line.

------ Output Format ------ 

- For each testcase, on the first line output the minimum possible size of array A satisfying the given property.
- On the next line output the elements of array A in any order. 

------ Constraints ------ 

$1 ≤ T ≤ 10^{5}$
$0 ≤ C < 2^{60}$
- It is guaranteed in the input that sum of lengths of arrays over all testcases does not exceed $10^{6}$.

----- Sample Input 1 ------ 
3
1
2
3
----- Sample Output 1 ------ 
1
1
2
1 3
1
3

----- explanation 1 ------ 
$\textbf{Test case}$ 1: $C=1$, $A$ can be $\{1\}$

$\textbf{Test case}$ 2: $C=2$, $A$ can be $\{1,3\}$

$\textbf{Test case}$ 3: $C=3$, $A$ can be $\{3\}$
original_problem.constraints:
time limit: 1 seconds
memory limit: 50000 bytes
original_problem.standard_solution_code:
for _ in range(int(input())):
	C = int(input())
	if C == 0:
		print('2\n1 1\n')
		continue
	b = ''
	while C > 0:
		b += str(C % 2)
		C = C // 2
	b = b[::-1]
	size = len(b)
	v = []
	prev = b[0]
	v.append(2 ** size - 1)
	for i in range(1, size):
		if b[i] == prev:
			continue
		v.append(2 ** (size - i) - 1)
		prev = b[i]
	print(len(v))
	print(' '.join(map(str, v)))
